educationalGoal: In the current education, the support for handicapped students is very important. Special supported education is significance not only for specific students but also for all students. The objectives of this course are to understand basic knowledge of special need education, and to consider the adequate methods for it.
advice: This course covers items as below. 1. Inclusive education 2. The system for special supported education 3. Specific methods for special supported education 4. Organizational initiatives for special supported education Students will learn basic knowledge of special need education, and acquire the adequate perspective on "handicap".
requiredKnowledge: ●Students should be especially aware that the content of this course is necessary for those who wish to be beyond special supported schools. ●Student who aim to be a teacher must attend this course.
